source.paraphrase: An exported signature is a contract other modules compile against. Its return type should be written, not inferred.

invariants.why: An inferred return type leaks implementation detail into the boundary. Renaming an internal helper silently changes every importer's type.
invariants.fixHint: Annotate the return type on the exported function or arrow function.
invariants.avoid: Marking the function async does not replace a return type. The promise still publishes an untyped boundary.

relations.why: Next.js server actions must be async functions even when they do not await anything.
relations.settle: Exclude the files that declare server actions (for example **/actions.ts or app/**/actions/**) from TS-AWAIT-001.

source.paraphrase: An async function that never awaits wraps its result for no reason. Either the suspension is missing or async is decoration.

invariants.why: A needless async hides whether the function suspends. Callers await a value that was already there.
invariants.fixHint: Remove async when nothing suspends, or await the asynchronous work the function performs.
invariants.avoid: Mentioning await in a comment does not suspend the function. Only an await expression counts.

source.paraphrase: A barrel should name what it republishes. A star re-export publishes bindings the barrel never reviewed.

invariants.why: Adding an export to the source module silently widens every star barrel above it, including name collisions across barrels.
invariants.fixHint: List the re-exported bindings by name in the barrel file.
invariants.avoid: Aliasing the star to a namespace still republishes every binding it does not name.
